hooks.command: echo '=== AIOS hot context (auto-loaded) ===' && echo '--- Home.md ---' && cat Home.md 2>/dev/null && echo && echo '--- Recent memory: AIOS/History/Log.md (newest first) ---' && head -25 AIOS/History/Log.md 2>/dev/null && echo && echo '--- Identity layers (AIOS/Systems/layers.tsv) ---' && grep -v '^#' AIOS/Systems/layers.tsv 2>/dev/null | awk -F'\t' 'NF>=2 {print "  " $1 " — " $2}' && echo && echo 'Read order: pick the layer this task belongs to, read <layer>/me.md, then AIOS/Maps/Vault Map.md + Skill Map.md. Never mix layers in one output, note, or shared file.'

Q=$(find "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/+/_sessions" -name '*.md' ! -empty 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/.state/' | grep -v '/.memory/' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$Q" -gt 0 ] && echo "AIOS: $Q pending session digest(s) — run /aios-ingest to compound them into the wiki." || true
